pull_request_body: Plans the migration of 49 test files that patch devops_cli internal names or import private names. Each file is rewritten to test through the public CLI interface over shared fakes from tests/support/fakes/. Private product code that exists only for a test patch is removed. No test deletes a behaviour check; each test still asserts the same outcome. The work follows ADR 0007 as amended by #2143 and the rules in docs/TESTING.md.
why: #2167: 49 test files added after the 2026-10-07 census patch devops_cli internal names or import private names. No child of #1307 owns them. They must test through public interfaces over shared fakes, as ADR 0007 and docs/TESTING.md require.
what_changes: Rewrite 49 test files to call public CLI commands and install shared fakes through fixtures instead of patching devops_cli private names
Remove private product code that exists only to be patched by a test, per #1307 Q27
Replace MagicMock instances with shared fakes from tests/support/fakes/
Add a spec requirement that tests in the 49-file set use public interfaces and shared fakes
feasibility: The context shows tests/ai/review/test_runner.py importing _check_and_warn_perimeter_changes, _execute_review_workflow, _record_review_metrics, _run_orchestrator_review and patching _load_file_analysis_metas and _print_analysis_metadata, confirming the private-import and patch pattern.
The context shows tests/ci/test_cache_fuzzing.py importing _worktree_divergent_paths and patching _get_git_output, confirming the pattern in the CI domain.
The context shows tests/llm_stream_fakes.py patching _shared_client, _create_http_client, _query_model_info and _max_attempts, confirming the pattern in the LLM client domain.
The context shows tests/commands/test_pr.py using shared fakes (GitHubApiFake, ProcessFake, ClockFake) and a cli fixture, confirming the target pattern already exists in the repository.

First checks the implementation runs: (1) grep -rn 'from devops_cli.* import _' tests/ to enumerate all private imports; (2) grep -rn 'patch("devops_cli' tests/ to enumerate all patch sites; (3) uv run devops ci test tests/ to confirm the baseline passes before changes.
existing_tool: No external tool covers this need. The repository already provides shared fakes in tests/support/fakes/ (GitFake, ProcessFake, ClockFake, GitHubApiFake, ModelFake, ScannerFake) and a cli fixture for CLI-level testing. The change reuses these internal fakes and the existing CliRunner pattern seen in tests/commands/test_pr.py. The change deletes private product code that existed only for test patches, such as the functions targeted by the 146 patch sites across 33 files.

decisions.decision: Rewrite tests to call the public CLI command via the cli fixture instead of importing and calling private functions directly
decisions.reason: ADR 0007 and docs/TESTING.md require tests to use public interfaces over shared fakes. The cli fixture pattern already exists in tests/commands/test_pr.py and is the established target pattern.

decisions.decision: Replace MagicMock instances with shared fakes from tests/support/fakes/
decisions.reason: The acceptance criteria state each double must be a shared fake from tests/support/fakes/ installed through its seam or fixture. MagicMock is an inline double that bypasses the shared fake contract.

decisions.decision: Remove private product code that exists only to be patched by a test
decisions.reason: #1307 Q27 specifies that product code needed only for a patch goes. Keeping dead private code adds maintenance cost without consumer value.

decisions.decision: Group the 49 files into 21 steps by domain
decisions.reason: Each step must fit the 40000-token budget with its files. Grouping by domain keeps related changes together and makes each step self-contained.

decisions.decision: Provide a spec delta for the test-public-interface capability
decisions.reason: The change removes private product code and alters the test suite's coupling to internals. The validator requires a spec delta when product code is removed, even if the code is private.

rejected.alternative: Make all private functions public by removing the underscore prefix
rejected.evidence: This would expose internal implementation details as a public API, violating the encapsulation that the underscore prefix signals. The acceptance criteria require tests to use the public CLI interface, not a widened module API.

rejected.alternative: Keep the patch sites and add a lint rule to suppress the warning
rejected.evidence: The acceptance criteria explicitly require zero patch sites and zero private imports. A lint suppression does not remove the coupling; it hides it. ADR 0007 requires the coupling to be removed, not suppressed.

rejected.alternative: Split the 49 files across multiple pull requests
rejected.evidence: The issue states this item is one child of #1307 for the files that no other child names. The acceptance criteria require all 49 files to be clean in one pull request. Splitting would leave files in a mixed state.

specs.purpose: Tests SHALL exercise product behavior through public interfaces and shared fakes, without patching private names or importing private symbols from devops_cli.

added.name: tests-use-public-interfaces
added.text: Tests in the 49-file set SHALL exercise product behavior through public CLI commands and shared fakes from tests/support/fakes/, without patching devops_cli private names or importing names that start with an underscore.

scenarios.name: no-private-patch-or-import
scenarios.when: a test file in the 49-file set is executed
scenarios.then: it patches no devops_cli module, class, function or attribute, and imports no name that starts with an underscore from devops_cli

scenarios.name: shared-fake-installed
scenarios.when: a test needs a double for a devops_cli dependency
scenarios.then: the double is a shared fake from tests/support/fakes/ installed through its seam or fixture
